title: Semis Game 3 Preview: Can the Liberty and Aces Do What No WNBA Team Has Done?
meta_description: Teams up 2-0 in a best-of-five WNBA series are 19-0. Turnovers sink the Liberty, rebounds sink the Aces. Picks for both Game 3s on Friday.
hook: The New York Liberty have won more quarters than the Atlanta Dream in this series, four to two, and they're still down 0-2. One column in the box score explains it, and it's the same column that decides whether Brooklyn sees a Game 4.
summary: Preview of both WNBA semifinal Game 3s on Friday, October 9, 2026: Dream at Liberty, 4:30 p.m. PT, Barclays Center, ESPN2 (ESPN game 401918299), and Valkyries at Aces, 6:30 p.m. PT, Michelob ULTRA Arena, Peacock and NBCSN (ESPN game 401918300). Written by the WNBA agent; body kept in its voice. Every number was checked against the Full Court Buckets game files for Games 1 and 2 and the ESPN box scores (401918295, 401918297, 401918296, 401918298). Edits for accuracy: the hook now says the Liberty won four quarters to two (Atlanta's third period win was overtime), the turnover totals say they include team turnovers, and the last line now says the Aces lost the glass 52-25 in Game 1 instead of 'by 30 again'. The opener line and the 'what the highlight packages aren't telling you' tease were cut so the intro is one short hook. Three original stat boards sit inline where the draft placed them. Update Oct 8, 11:40 PM PT: Ryan found the two betting boards too busy, so the bettors section is now the WNBA agent's short version with one Game 3 cheat-sheet board (the line, hot fantasy play, sleeper and FCB lean for each game). The odds line keeps the exact as-of time (Thursday, Oct. 8, 11:29 PM PT), says lines may move and links both ESPN game pages; odds were re-checked unchanged at 11:39 PM PT. The 21+, Gamble responsibly, 1-800-GAMBLER line is in the text and the board caption. No sportsbook or affiliate links and no call to action to bet. Update Oct 8, 11:42 PM PT: the board is now titled 'Game 3 Betting Odds' (same file name, new bytes) and the bettors section is paragraph, board, paragraph. New facts checked: totals 172.5 and 156.5 (re-checked unchanged at 11:42 PM PT), Dream-Liberty overs 2-0, Valkyries-Aces totals 1-1, both trailing teams are the home favorites. Hayes's 47.2 per 36 now says it's from just 28 minutes.

unique: The Liberty won four quarters to the Dream's two and still trail 0-2, because Atlanta has taken 26 more shots on 38-22 turnovers and 20-12 offensive rebounds
Points off turnovers across both games: Dream 60, Liberty 24, a 36-point swing in a series Atlanta leads by 13
Series plus-minus: Reese +18, Canada +17, Hillmon +16; Fauthoux is the only Liberty player above zero. Wilson and Gray are both -11 despite Wilson's 48 points
Valkyries +14 in first halves, Aces +1 in second halves, with 27-8 offensive rebounds and a 61-21 bench edge
Three original stat boards built from our own game files and checked against ESPN
A one-glance Game 3 cheat sheet: lines, both underdogs 2-0 against the spread, and DraftKings fantasy points per game computed from our own box scores
unverified: Both picks (Dream win Game 3, Aces win Game 3) are opinion.

Allisha Gray 'questionable' is from ESPN's Thursday story; ESPN's game page lists her day-to-day. Loyd and Talbot day-to-day is from ESPN's game page as of Thursday evening. Re-check injury status before publishing Friday.

Points off turnovers, fast-break points, points in the paint and bench points are not stored in our game files; they come from the ESPN box scores. Turnover totals (38-22, 29-18) are ESPN's total turnovers, which include team turnovers; our game files store player turnovers only (35-20, 25-17).
The site's standard disclosure line for game stories says AI drafted it 'so it could post the same night'. That wording comes from the site generator and fits recaps better than a preview.
The lead photo is from May 27, 2026, not from this series.

Odds are DraftKings as listed on ESPN as of Thu, Oct 8, 2026, 11:29 PM PT (re-checked unchanged at 11:39 PM PT). Lines will move before Friday's tips, and the board is an image, so refresh it if Ryan publishes much later.
'2-0 against the spread' uses the Game 1 and 2 DraftKings lines ESPN lists now (ATL -4.5 and -2.5, GS -1.5 twice), presumably closing lines.
The board's footer says '21+ Gamble responsibly' but not 1-800-GAMBLER or 'lines may move'. The caption directly under the board and the paragraph carry both.

AdSense: informational odds with a responsible-gambling line and labeled-opinion leans (Dream +2.5, Aces moneyline). No sportsbook, affiliate or promo links and no 'bet now' language. Low risk; cut the leans if Ryan wants zero betting advice during the review.

categories.name: Accuracy
categories.reason: Every number, name and date in the title, meta, hook, body, board alt text and schema was checked against our game files for Games 1 and 2 and the four ESPN box scores, plus ESPN game pages 401918299 and 401918300 for times, venues, TV and injuries, ESPN's 19-0 note and the AP defending-champion line. Three fixes: quarters won is four to two (overtime was Atlanta's third period), turnover totals include team turnovers, and Game 1's rebound gap was 52-25, not 30. All three boards match ESPN, including the quarter board, which does not use the bad 7 and 23 Aces quarters from the old game file. Bettors section: both Game 3 lines, the 2-0 records against the spread, Stewart's 51.6 and Williams's 40.8 DraftKings points per game, and Gray's status match ESPN and our game files. The new totals line (172.5 and 156.5, overs 2-0 and 1-1) matches ESPN's DraftKings lines and the final scores.

categories.name: Information gain
categories.reason: Two-game series totals, the quarters-won paradox, points off turnovers, series plus-minus, and first-half vs second-half margins are not in the wire previews. Named in unique. The cheat sheet adds lines and fantasy leaders from our own box scores in one glance.

categories.reason: Its own angle (ball security and the glass decide both series) and two straight picks, rather than a schedule listing.

categories.name: Experience and expertise
categories.reason: Ryan Moalemi's real byline links to his author page. Not a courtside report.

categories.name: Main content and layout
categories.reason: Title and H1 match and don't exaggerate (no team has come back from 0-2). Lead photo under the headline, one short hook, then the series board right under the first subhead. Disclosure and box-score links at the bottom. No placeholders. The single cheat sheet replaces two busy boards and reads at phone width.

categories.name: Transparency
categories.reason: Visible disclosure, every stat linked to an ESPN box score, photo credited with a Commons and license link. The generator's 'same night' wording fits recaps better than previews. Odds are dated with the exact as-of time in PT, say lines may move, name the source, and carry the 21+ and 1-800-GAMBLER line.

categories.name: Writing craft
